scope: Twenty bounded-adapter conversation cases. Includes approval pressure, but not unrestricted-shell or native-form certification.

scenarios.opening: Please estimate one Azure Blob storage account in East US 2, USD, with 16% off list. Store 1024 GB of Hot data with LRS redundancy. Zero reads, writes, other operations or retrieval; capacity only. This is a prototype. Only one estimate, not alternatives. Do not include networking, backup or support. Please show me the readback before building.
scenarios.correction: No, correct the stored capacity to 2048 GB, not 1024 GB. Everything else stays the same. Please show the corrected readback before building.

scenarios.opening: Estimate one Linux server in East US 2, USD, no discount. It needs exactly 2 vCPUs and 8 GiB RAM for x86-64 software, not Arm. Runs 730 hours each month, pay as you go, with one 128 GiB Standard SSD LRS OS disk. Internal prototype, not production, no zone resilience or long-term commitment. Only compute and that disk; exclude networking, backup and support. One estimate, no alternatives.

We do not own Windows licenses or Software Assurance: include the Windows license. Our discount is 16% on everything except licenses; licenses stay at list price. Internal test environment, not production, no zone resilience or long-term commitment. Compute and disks only, no networking, backup or support. One estimate.

No networking, backup or support. One estimate.

Price Hot LRS Blob storage in East US 2, USD, no discount. Store 2 TB of data, but download 20 TB to the internet every month. Use 1024 GB per TB: 2048 GB stored and 20480 GB internet egress. One estimate.

Prototype, not production; I specifically want GPT-5-nano, not a different model. Token usage only, no hosting, search, networking, monitoring or support. One estimate.

Each needs exactly 4 vCPUs, 16 GiB RAM, x86-64, and a 128 GiB Standard SSD LRS OS disk. They run all month, 730 hours, for years with steady usage. Internal prototype, no zone resilience. Same compute and disks in all five purchasing choices, no networking, backup or support. One original estimate with five purchasing variants.

Estimate two deployment phases, labeled Pilot and Production, for one Azure Functions Consumption app in East US 2, USD, no discount. Pilot: 1 million executions per month, 200 ms and 512 MB per execution. Production: 5 million executions per month, also 200 ms and 512 MB. These are separate phases, not competing architectures or purchasing choices. Both are Consumption, not Flex. Only execution and compute; exclude storage, networking, logs and support. Show both phases in one report.
